gateSources.Wellerpoort: inventory 140046 ('Wellerpoort of Hasseltse poort'); position uncertain
gateSources.Keulerpoort: inventory 140046 ('Keulerpoort, Nerempoort of Akense poort'); position uncertain

walls.source: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Borgloon' (https://id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140046)
walls.note: Borgloon (Looz), old seat of the counts of Loon: wall and four gates from shortly after 1200, traced from the Ferraris map (1777), where the line is a ditch and hedge. Besieged by Lorraine in 1654.

landmarks.y1650: Romanesque collegiate church on the Speelhof (chapter of canons), main bell tower; Borgloon was the old seat of the counts of Loon.
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Borgloon' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140046)

landmarks.y1650: Council house on the Markt ('sgrevenhuys'); the present Renaissance town hall dates from 1680 (after 1650).
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Borgloon' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140046)

landmarks.y1650: Hospital chapel of the Knights of St John at the Graethempoort, round which the beguinage grew (burnt by Lorraine troops in 1654).
landmarks.src: Inventaris Onroerend Erfgoed, 'Historische stadskern van Borgloon' (id.erfgoed.net/erfgoedobjecten/140046)

ruler.name: Prinsbisdom Luik
ruler.sovereign: Prince-bishop Ferdinand of Bavaria (1612-50), then Maximilian Henry of Bavaria (elected 1650); neutral in the Franco-Spanish war (neutrality recognised by Spain only in 1654, see history-check F76)

overworld.note: coordinates are overworld metres: town-local metres (around origin) + centre; 1:1 scale inside radius
